summary: Mode-based card routing (AddHand/Discard/PlayForFree/PlayForCost) is reimplemented directly in TO-BE via StageRevealMovesAsync/PlayPermanentCards, whereas AS-IS RevealDeckTopCardsAndSelect only sets up SelectCardEffect and calls Activate() (a separate file) which performs the actual mode routing internally — cannot verify 1:1 from this file pair alone (logic delegated to unseen SelectCardEffect.cs); the incremental select loop's inability to un-pick an already-chosen card to satisfy canEndSelectCondition is an acknowledged gap (design item RD-W3-1, header comment).

DNADigivolvePermanentsIntoHandOrTrashCard's real body (AS-IS :458-624, SetJogressEvoRootsController/PunRPC/WaitUntil flow) is NOT present in this TO-BE file — it is a thin AS-IS-signature wrapper forwarding to a 'substrate overload' in another file; cannot verify 1:1 from this pair. DNADigivolveWithHandOrTrashCardIntoHandOrTrash substitutes AS-IS's actual FieldPermanents slot write (PlayTempPermanent, with real null-back) for a read-only TempMaterialView snapshot (no slot write) — a documented non-trivial mechanism substitution (RD-S3-BT17_095), not a simple substrate translation. successProcess/failedProcess parameter types changed from AS-IS raw IEnumerator to TO-BE Func<Task> (delegate-shape change, even though unused by the body).

BounceTamer: the AS-IS HandBounceClaass bounce process's PRE cut-in windows (WhenReturntoHandAnyone/WhenRemoveField, CardController.cs:2644-2660) are explicitly acknowledged in the header comment as NOT implemented by the mirror's sink-based ReturnToHand mapping (tracked separately as design item R2-P2-2) — a real, documented behavioural gap.

TO-BE ports only the CardColor enum (per its own header comment: 'only the members ported effect code needs so far are mirrored here'). The entire AS-IS CEntity_Base ScriptableObject class is absent: CardIndex, cardColors, PlayCost, EvoCosts, Level, CardName_JPN/ENG, Form_JPN/ENG, Attribute_JPN/ENG, Type_JPN/ENG, CardSpriteName, cardKind, 6 effect-description fields, CardEffectClassName, DP, rarity, OverflowMemory, LinkDP/LinkEffect/LinkRequirement, dualEffect, OptionCardColorRequirements/OptionEffect, HasInhetitedEffect/HasSecutiryEffect, CardID, MaxCountInDeck, HasLoadStarted/CardSprite/LoadCardImage/GetCardSprite, IsACE/IsStandardValid/IsDualCard, RegulationMark (40-case switch), SetID, IsPermanent, CardIndex_String, GetParseByUnderBar/GetParseByHyphen, SameCardIDCount, isParallel, HasLevel, HasCost/HasPlayCost/HasUseCost — plus the CardKind enum, EvoCost class, and Rarity enum — are all missing.
